caption: The drawing depicts a three-tiered wooden stand with rounded edges and three small red legs. The stand is predominantly yellow with red accents. Patterns of red dots and starburst designs are present on each tier and on the tall, rounded backboard. The backboard is decorated with two circular starburst patterns, one large near the top and a smaller one surrounding a central oval hole. Each of the three semicircular shelves or tiers wraps around a cylindrical column, all painted yellow with evenly spaced red dots. On the top shelf, there is a round, shallow red container holding a mound of gray material. The surfaces of the tiers and bottom platform are decorated with radiating lines resembling sunrays in red, converging towards the central columns. The overall composition is vertically oriented and symmetrically arranged, with the decorative details corresponding from tier to tier.
title: Zoar Thread Holder
